scope: Read-only source definitions; no host/state/native inspection or behavior tests

findings.title: Definition-side paper supply cannot reach mature research
findings.finding: Player-obtainable paper from listed commands totals6: catalogue1,Kael1,two shop commands2+2. Mandatory mature route needs8, or9 with the social report. Shop holds6 but only4 is exposed by its once-only commands.
findings.qualification: Host/state/native intentionally not reviewed; an explicit entry paper grant could change this result.
findings.suggestedRepair: Provide enough counted reachable paper for each selected mature alternative and account for remaining finite stock.

findings.title: Prepared physical device support needs current reserved/held means
findings.finding: Known root lamp issue: duration commands reserve the lamp but repeat held-lamp support at completion. Unique review finding: tether returns the same player rope and saves tetherPrepared, but prepared/ordinary retrieval do not require or reserve current rope, so storing/selling it preserves advertised physical tether use.
findings.qualification: Root already sent the lamp completion finding to the writer; no fix is verified here.
findings.suggestedRepair: Count only the exact lamp reservation belonging to the supported job at completion; prepared/ordinary retrieval need actual held rope or a real installed tether owner.

findings.title: Player receipts reveal author-only future-system names
findings.finding: Ibery's temporal instruction names Guardian template,Black Room,soul marker,future month and memory packet although only continuous local notes were observed. Closure names the festival invasion. Negative entitlement wording still conveys future-system vocabulary to the player.
findings.qualification: Baseline author-only scope exclusions are appropriate in source/docs; these names are the player-knowledge receipt issue.
findings.suggestedRepair: Keep the player account to actual continuous observations, received testimony and unverified temporal claims; retain future-source exclusions in author-only baseline/docs.

findings.title: Retained hazard and later control mastery lack gameplay consumers
findings.finding: Hazard avoided/deterred/alarmed and forecast residue_and_movement are written but no ids/content/actions predicate consumes them. Return/mature controls ignore retained hazard. Operator mastery grows1→2→3 but all executable consumers gate>=1 and no later mastery band/function changes cost,precision,response or return use.
findings.qualification: Temporary injuries,real mana/material costs,received research standing and the mature paid demonstration are functional; this finding targets the named write-only dispositions and post1operator counter.
findings.suggestedRepair: One finite aftermath inspection/recovery/use should depend on actual retained hazard; one selected mature-control function or alternative should consume the extra mastery if it is described as functional progression.

findings.title: Advertised calibration count exceeds Nora's finite mana
findings.finding: Nora starts18personalMana;assembly spends2;three advertised six-charge calibrations need18more. Maximum supported calibrations after assembly is floor16/6=2,leaving4unusable under the six-charge definition.
findings.qualification: No automatic mana recovery or NPC refill appears in reviewed definitions,which correctly preserves finite means.
findings.suggestedRepair: Disclose at most two available full calibrations/remove unreachable third,or author a distinct supported partial calibration from remaining actual mana.
